messages:
Aisha (CS): FYI: short incident affecting onboarding this afternoon. Need quick customer note + credit policy.
Dev (Eng): Cause: upstream webhook 5xx spikes triggered retry storm; duplicates entered the queue. Patch rolled (retry cap + dedupe) at 15:42 UTC. Backfill running.
Ravi (Legal): Tone: use 'experienced a service disruption' and 'we will evaluate and apply' for credits. No amounts in public copy.
Tom (Support): For customers in renewal P90, request immediate CS outreach. Need export of impacted tenants.
Nora (PM): Recommend two office hours (APAC + EMEA/US) and a one-question survey after recovery.
Aisha (CS): Draft message (short, non-technical):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We experienced a service disruption affecting onboarding for a subset of customers between 15:25 and 15:45 UTC. Some onboarding steps were delayed or processed more than once.

What we9re doing:
- Deployed a fix and added deduplication safeguards.
- Running an automated remediation; most customers should be recovered within 3	6 hours.
- We will evaluate impacted accounts for a one-time credit and your CS contact will reach out if applicable.

If you want a walkthrough, join our office hours or reply to this message. We9re sorry for the disruption.

The Redwood Inference Team
```
Dev (Eng): Remediation started 15:48 UTC, rate-limited. ~95% auto-recover, ~5% manual. Full RCA draft in 48h.
Aisha (CS): @InfraBot please export impacted_onboards_300111.
InfraBot: export-run queued. Job ID EB-300111-C. ETA 7m.
Tom (Support): On export complete I'll start priority outreach for renewals. Proposal: trial=$50, SMB=$150, Mid=$400; escalate enterprise to PM. CS confirm?
Nora (PM): Approve tiers for initial outreach; PM will handle enterprise exceptions.
Aisha (CS): Plan: send first tranche at 17:00 UTC, post status, open office hours tomorrow 14:00 & 22:00 UTC. Will update thread after send.
InfraBot: export-run complete. s3://redwood-exports/EB-300111-C.zip
Tom (Support): Starting renewals outreach now. Posting progress in #support after 10 contacts.
Aisha (CS): Closing planning thread; will reopen for RCA review and final customer follow-ups. Thanks all. :pray:
